expectedText: Last month I saw a vacancy at a community center and sent an application. I wanted the position because I enjoy helping people find useful information. At the interview, the manager asked about my experience. I described a library event where a colleague and I worked as a team. My example showed that I could listen to a customer and finish a task carefully. I also asked about the wage and the first responsibility in the department. The employer did not give me a decision that day, so I wrote down the date for a reply. After the interview, I planned to resume volunteering and practice another example for my career goal.
